title: Initiative register row
description: A change or experiment that addresses one or more opportunities (ontology: Initiative, prefix INI). One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: initiative_id, opportunity_ids (an initiative addresses at least one opportunity; one without is solution-first), hypothesis and change (what is changed and why it should work) and status. Expected metrics, effect, dependencies and owner are refined during design.
